nodes.label: HTTP Error Page Templates
nodes.rationale:
The two error pages are registered inconsistently: 500.html wraps its markup in {{define "templates/html/errors/500"}} while 404.html is bare

404

with no define block. 404 therefore cannot be resolved by template name and must be loaded by Gin filename convention (no extension / errors/404), so any rename or loader change can break error rendering silently.
